_help: Optional per-company settings for fetch_jobs.py, keyed by the exact name in companies.csv. extra_pages: more pages to render besides careers_url. text_list: jobs are the plain lines between the 'start' line and the 'end' line (for pages whose jobs are not links). job_filter: keep only jobs whose card text contains one of these words (for portals shared by several companies). manual: skip the company and give this reason (it is listed in check_manually.csv).

Technion.manual: job titles are in collapsed sections that render hidden

Zimin Institute (Technion).manual: uses the Technion jobs page, whose titles render hidden
